scope.browser_mutations: Synthetic browser-local case data only; protected API paths in consent regressions use deterministic mocks.

findings.title: Stale tabs overwrite saved timeline evidence or resurrect deleted cases
reproduction: Open one synthetic case in two pages sharing localStorage.
Tab B saves a new event.
Stale tab A saves a different event.
findings.before: Only tab A event remains in storage; tab B saved evidence is silently replaced.
findings.fix: Timeline writes compare the latest persisted timeline with the displayed baseline. Delete and replacement restore compare the reviewed whole case, including attached inputs. Conflicts preserve typed input and the unsaved draft, provide a draft download, and require an explicit confirmed load of the latest case.
verification: Real two-page stale event and correction after another tab decision are rejected with saved bytes preserved.
A stale tab cannot resurrect a deleted case.
Stale deletion cannot discard newly attached deduction evidence.
Restore preview replacement rejects a subsequently changed target; importing as a separate case remains available.

findings.title: Closed letter regenerates against a cleared case after language switch
reproduction: Open and close a lock letter.
Create another case so there is no active timeline.
findings.before: A page error reads requestType from null; old closed letter state retains stale actions.
findings.fix: Regenerate only an open current dialog. Case changes close the letter and clear body, subject, recipient, generation callback and share/copy/download actions.
verification: Case reset followed by language switch emits no page errors.
Closed letter body is empty, copy/download are disabled, and mail/WhatsApp hrefs are absent.

findings.title: Language switching exits correction view and loses unsaved edits when reopened
findings.observed_on: public e1e509d30ac97912; independently reproduced in Chromium and WebKit
reproduction: Open Edit details for a saved case.
Choose Hindi, then reopen Edit details.
findings.before: Language render hides the edit form; reopening restores the saved value over the typed draft.
findings.fix: Track details-editing view independently of whether a timeline exists; language rendering retains the form and its field values.
verification: Focused Chromium regression preserves visible form, typed hospital and unchanged saved bytes.
Independent Chromium and WebKit confirmation is recorded in qa/review-ui.json.

findings.title: Stale deduction attachment can replace newer lines or attach to a different claim restored over the same ID
findings.observed_on: source audit and deterministic browser/unit reproduction
findings.before: Attachment writes used the latest case ID without checking the loaded deduction inputs or claim identity.
findings.fix: Compare reviewed deductions and stable claim identity fields (ID, insurer, TPA, hospital, city, request type and submitted time). Keep unrelated newer events/decisions from current storage.
verification: Two-page stale line replacement is rejected while its reviewed input remains visible.
A fresh attachment confirmation preserves another tab event.
A same-insurer replacement with a different hospital/submission time rejects the original claim attachment.

findings.title: Draft export can combine an old case identity with another tab newer deductions
findings.observed_on: independent source review and source browser reproduction
findings.fix: Use fresh saved deductions only when stable case identity matches the exported timeline. Otherwise preserve the coherent displayed baseline deductions, or none after an insurer change.
verification: Focused two-page regression keeps original Care draft separate from newer HDFC deductions without modifying newer storage.
Independent reviewer confirmed original Care100 deductions plus unsaved event survive export while HDFC222 remains untouched.

findings.title: Blocked storage access is mislabeled as corrupt saved data
findings.fix: Distinguish read access exceptions from malformed contents; hide raw recovery download when bytes cannot be read.
verification: Unit regression classifies SecurityError as unavailable and does not modify original bytes.
Independent browser check shows storage error with raw recovery hidden and no page errors.

coverage: report and AI consent withdrawal during delayed verification

preserved_contracts: No local-case schema change or account requirement.

Backup parsing still validates allowed keys, scalar types, known insurer/TPA IDs, real calendar dates, lengths/counts and deduction confirmation consistency; old historical dates and pre-correction events remain allowed.
Backup import/transfer restore requires an explicit preview decision; receipt erase tokens are excluded.
Confirmed-valid deduction lines retain clarification wording and policy/arithmetic confirmation behavior.
Storage failure remains separate from a concurrent-edit conflict; malformed saved bytes are not automatically overwritten.
New quota-failed case retains an in-memory clock/export path; existing conflicting draft remains downloadable.
limitations: Optimistic localStorage compare/read/write checks are not an atomic cross-renderer transaction. They prevent demonstrated sequential stale-tab writes; no strict simultaneous-write serialization guarantee is claimed.

follow_up_boundaries.observation: transferRequest waits for Turnstile internally; generation is checked before that request helper and after response, not immediately before fetch. A case change during verification may create an orphan ciphertext transfer or consume a lookup before the result is discarded.
follow_up_boundaries.data_boundary: Plaintext and decryption key stay local; received backup still cannot overwrite without preview.
follow_up_boundaries.resolution: A generation callback is checked immediately after verification resolves, before fetch. Regression reproduced one unwanted create POST before the fix; canceled create and lookup send zero requests afterward. See qa/review-transfer-cancellation.json.
